content: The Eep module's user shall not call the Eep_Cancel() function during a running Eep_MainFunction() function. [SWS_Eep_00136] can be achieved by one of the following scheduling configurations: • Possibility 1: the job functions of the NVRAM manager and the EEPROM driver are synchronized (e.g. called sequentially within one task) 38 of 67 Document ID 21: AUTOSAR_SWS_EEPROMDriver Specification of EEPROM Driver AUTOSAR CP R22-11 • Possibility 2: the task that calls the Eep_MainFunction function cannot be pre- empted by another task.
